<function name="SetHorizontalFOV" parent="ProjectedTexture" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the horizontal angle of projection without affecting the vertical angle.

You must call <page>ProjectedTexture:Update</page> after using this function for it to take effect.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="hFOV" type="number">The new horizontal Field Of View for the projected texture. Must be in range between 0 and 180.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
